name: Monterrubio (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of golden yellow, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Monterrubio (three blue fesses on yellow, the aqueduct on red and crossed keys).
history: Monterrubio adopted its arms and flag officially on 22 February 2003, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 11 June 2003; the flag is barry of gold, yellow and blue, with the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.

features.role: Monterrubio arms — three blue fesses on yellow, the aqueduct on red and crossed keys
